title: S222--Sources Sought - Hazardous Waste Removal/Disposal  Northeast Ohio VA Healthcare System - Cleveland, OH
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > 250-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 10 (36C250)
description:
Hazardous Waste Pickup, Transportation, and Disposal Services, Cleveland VA Medical Center and Supported CBOCs

CORRECTION NOTICE: This notice re-issues Sources Sought 36C25026Q0957, which closed on September 14, 2026. Question #4 of that notice referred to "Scrap Metal Recycling services" in error. The requirement is for hazardous waste services. Questions #4 through #7 below replace the original Question #4. Firms that responded to the original notice may revise and resubmit their responses, answering Questions #4 through #7, but are not required to. Firms that did not respond are encouraged to respond now.
The Network Contracting Office (NCO 10) is seeking vendors to perform Hazardous Waste Pickup, Transportation, and Disposal Services at the Cleveland VA Medical Center and its supported Community Based Outpatient Clinics (CBOCs).
This is a Sources Sought to identify capable sources and request industry feedback ONLY. This notice does not constitute a commitment by the Government. Interested parties are asked to answer the questions below AND submit a capability statement that clearly and convincingly demonstrates their ability to fulfill the requirement.
The capability statement and answers to the questions below must be submitted electronically by email to Joshua.Kovar@VA.gov no later than 1:30 PM EST on November 30, 2026.
As part of market research, this Sources Sought is intended to determine whether an adequate number of qualified, interested contractors exists that are capable of providing the requirement. Industry feedback is requested to ensure the VA has not created a "de facto sole source" requirement. The Government may use the responses for information and planning purposes.

DRAFT SCOPE: The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) is conducting market research to identify qualified sources capable of providing hazardous waste services at the Cleveland VA Medical Center and a number of CBOCs throughout Northeast, Central, and Northwest Ohio. The contractor will provide on-site support, packaging, transportation, and treatment and disposal of hazardous waste.
The estimated hazardous waste volume is approximately 68,000 to 75,000 pounds per year. This estimate is provided solely for informational and market research purposes. The forthcoming solicitation will include a refined workload estimate based on updated facility data.
The Government is proposing an Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) contract with a five-year ordering period. The Government anticipates placing a task order each year to cover that year's requirements.

QUESTIONS FOR INDUSTRY
Question #1. Are you interested in providing a quote for this requirement? (Yes / No)
Question #2. Please provide your company name, address, UEI, and a point of contact. State your business size under the NAICS code below and any SBA certifications (for example, SDVOSB, VOSB, WOSB, EDWOSB, HUBZone, 8(a), small business). Veteran-owned firms should state their SBA VetCert status.
Question #3. What is your current scope of operations and locations of service? Where do you currently work, and what is your maximum service area? Please state your ability to perform in Cleveland and in the CBOC locations across Northeast, Central, and Northwest Ohio.
Question #4: Collection and packaging. Does your firm self-perform hazardous waste collection and on-site packaging with its own employees? (Yes / No) If no, what type of subcontractor would you use?
Question #5: Transportation. Does your firm self-perform hazardous waste transportation with its own vehicles and drivers? (Yes / No) If no, what type of subcontractor would you use?
Question #6: Treatment and disposal. Does your firm own or operate the permitted facility that treats or disposes of the hazardous waste? (Yes / No) If no, what type of subcontractor or facility would you use?
Question #7: Licenses and permits. Does your firm hold, or have access through a subcontractor, the federal and state licenses and permits required to transport and dispose of hazardous waste in Ohio? (Yes / No)

Answers to Questions #4 through #7 are for market research only and will help the Government understand industry practices and self-performance capabilities.

CAPABILITY STATEMENT
Please provide a capability statement that supports this requirement. Include relevant past performance, preferably hazardous waste services at a medical center or similar healthcare facility.

NAICS AND PSC
The applicable NAICS code is 562211, Hazardous Waste Treatment and Disposal, with a small business size standard of $47.0 million. The Product Service Code is S222, Housekeeping   Waste Treatment/Storage.
Businesses of all sizes are encouraged to respond. Each respondent must identify its business size in its capability statement and answer the questions above.

DISCLAIMER
This Sources Sought is only for the purpose of identifying potential sources as part of market research. No Request for Proposal (RFP), Request for Quote (RFQ), or Invitation for Bid (IFB) exists. Responses are not quotes, proposals, or bids on which the VA can issue a contract. This notice is issued for information and planning purposes only. The Government does not intend to award a contract based only on responses to this Sources Sought. Responses will not be returned. Responders are solely responsible for all expenses associated with responding, and the VA will not pay for information received. Do not submit pricing information.
